subject.title: Crestodian talk-to-agent command can miss the app handoff

question: Should exact Crestodian host-navigation commands such as `talk to agent` bypass the usable-model conversation path and return the app handoff deterministically?
rationale: The bug is clear from source, but the current design makes normal Crestodian chat model-led when a backend is usable, and the protected labels already mark this boundary as requiring maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve exact host-navigation bypass
options.body: Treat exact documented navigation commands as host-owned operations before model turns and review the linked PR toward that behavior.

options.title: Keep model-led handoff
options.body: Leave the command dependent on the model calling `open_agent` and update docs/onboarding copy so it no longer promises deterministic handoff.

options.title: Limit to onboarding surface
options.body: Apply the deterministic bypass only for macOS onboarding and leave general Crestodian chat model-led.

recommendation.title: Approve exact host-navigation bypass
recommendation.body: Treat exact documented navigation commands as host-owned operations before model turns and review the linked PR toward that behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked fix PR and is the live assignee for this issue.
